referenceFidelity.findings: Warm solid oak, vertical boarded counter, four iron stools, light rear wall, bottle shelving and espresso block reflect documented industrial cafe references.

construction.findings: Counter front panel rhythm is consistent, stool metal feet meet ground and seat under a continuous top; shelves fit the rear tile wall, bottle necks are connected.

readability.findings: At phone size the long oak bar, dark stools and repeated bottle shelves remain distinct; fine bottle labels were deliberately omitted.

motion.findings: Intentionally static environment ensemble; no rig, animation, root motion or gameplay behavior requested.

secondPass.findings: Second assessment checked rear wall closure, stool repeat centers and top edge from opposite view. No floaters or unintended counter/shelf crossings observed.

userAcceptance.note: User requested production; no artistic acceptance of this specific revision has been given.

limitations: Research-informed modular interpretation; furniture measurements are inferred, not certified as-built specifications.
